name: SSRF Guard e Download Seguro de Mídia

security_capabilities_verified: SSRF prevention covering all reserved IPv4 ranges (CGNAT 100.64.0.0/10, Benchmarking 198.18.0.0/15, IETF 192.0.0.0/24)
SSRF prevention covering IPv6 translation (64:ff9b::/96) and documentation (2001:db8::/32)
Strict blocking of cloud metadata services (169.254.169.254, metadata.google.internal, instance-data)
Detection of alternative IP representations (decimal integers, octals with leading zeros, hex, URL-encoded hex/decimal, non-4-segment dotted IPs)
DNS resolution lookup verification across all resolved addresses before connection establishment
Manual HTTP redirect following up to maxRedirects (3) with mandatory destination re-validation per hop
Safe media streaming with hard byte capping (maxSizeBytes), immediate socket abort/cancellation and zero memory bloat
Pre-flight Content-Length check rejecting oversized payloads before reading response body
MIME type allowlist enforcement protecting against unauthorized file types
Binary file signature (magic bytes) verification for JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, PDF, OGG, MP4, MP3
Immediate rejection of dangerous formats (Windows PE / MZ, Linux ELF, HTML documents, and embedded scripts)
Real-time incremental SHA-256 hash generation during stream consumption
Elimination of ambient NODE_ENV === 'test' bypasses in adapters in favor of explicit allowLocalTest parameter

acceptance_criteria.evidence: ssrf-guard.ts implementa bloqueio a faixas CGNAT, benchmarking, translation, documentacao e deteccao precisa de formatos alternativos de IP sem falso positivo.
safeFetchWithSsrfGuard re-valida rigorosamente cada salto de redirecionamento HTTP 3xx e bloqueia qualquer desvio para loopback ou cloud metadata.
downloadMediaStream e downloadMediaToStream executam streaming com controle estrito de teto (maxSizeBytes) e abort imediato ao exceder cota.
verifyMediaMagicBytes valida assinaturas binarias legitimas e bloqueia payloads perigosos (executaveis PE/ELF, HTML e scripts) disfarçados de imagem.
WahaAdapter e utilitarios exigem explicitamente allowLocalTest: true, eliminando checagens silenciosas de NODE_ENV.
Suíte hermética com 26 testes em http-operational-security.test.ts e 347 testes no monorepo aprovados com 100% de sucesso.
